data.name: Brahmahadisha
data.gender_notes: Brahmahadisha is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Name of the Hindu god, Brahma, who is the creator of the universe in Hinduism. The name Brahmahadisha carries the meaning “Lord of Brahma” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Brahmahadisha usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of brahma and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Brahmahadisha belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord of Brahma.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Brahmahadisha total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_sanskrit.name: ब्रह्महदिष
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Brahma, the creator god, and hadisha, the giver or bestower. The name signifies the bestower of Brahma's blessings.

in_hindi.name: ब्रह्महदिष
in_hindi.long_meaning: ब्रह्म द्वारा दिया गया शक्ति या बधाई (Brahma-dia-gaya shakti yaa badhai). The name signifies the bestower of Brahma's blessings.

in_tamil.name: பிரமகதிஷ
in_tamil.long_meaning: பிரம் தொழில் அவர்கள் அவர்கள் அடிக்கலையில் வைத்தல் (Brahma tozhil avarkal avarkal adikkalaiyil vittal). The name signifies the bestower of Brahma's blessings.

in_telugu.name: బ్రహ్మహదిష
in_telugu.long_meaning: బ్రహ్మ దయయేశ్వర్ (Brahma daya-yeshvar) + హదిష (Hadisha). The name signifies the bestower of Brahma's blessings.

in_marathi.name: Brahmahadisha
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of Brahma
in_marathi.long_meaning: Brahmahadisha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Name of the Hindu god, Brahma, who is the creator of the universe in Hinduism.
